meaning:
αἱμορροέω,
(αἷμα, ῥέω), [in LXX: Lev.15:33 (דָּוֶה) * ;]
to lose blood, suffer from a flow of blood (Hipp.): Mat.9:20.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: which was diseased with an issue of blood

elsewhere.note: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
